narr: Scattered thunderstorms associated with a surface trough produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central and south central Virginia.
ev: Some road closures due to flash flooding were reported in the city of Richmond.
Flash flooding was reported along Hull Street in both directions near North Bailey Bridge Road.
Flash flooding was reported along Elkhardt Road and Ruthers Road. Road was closed due to flooding.
Portions of Dogtown Road were reported flooded.
Street flooding was reported, with a street reported closed. Vehicles were stranded.
Flash flooding was reported in the vicinity of Bible Road and Deep Creek Road.
Flash flooding was reported along Dearing Avenue near Darvills Road.
Flash flooding was reported along Piney Green Road. Portion of the road was closed.
Significant flash flooding was reported on 4th Street in Blackstone.
